svg.title: Patchy contest — 010 / No early hint control — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 010 / No early hint control, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 has no visual presence in this control; its underlying state is still dark. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible.
svg.text: OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
THE ALERT, BOARD AND PIVOT DO NOT DISCLOSE THE WHOLE EVENT.
010.3–4 / disputed scorer accounts; design / fixed response boundary
